text:
marie: Heads-up: Acadia onprem preflight failing — artifact sync blocked by unsigned images and missing CA cert for edge-router. See below.

alex: thanks. which images? registry logs?

marie: registry shows 403 on pull for artifacts.redwood.ai/acadia/acme-edge:v3. Error: 'signature verification failed'. They said air-gapped environment, vendor-signed images only.

sara: @alex can you confirm if our artifact signer ran on the acacia job? last run 03/02

alex: I checked: signing pipeline failed at `gpg: no secret key` on 03/02 21:14. Re-run ticket created: INF-5123

dev-bot: INF-5123 signed by pipeline requeued, started 1767778920

nate: @marie network ticket also shows egress NAT missing for their management CIDR — firewall denies outbound to our artifact mirror.

marie: right. need ops owner for firewall change. @leo?

leo: I can do NAT rules. Need customer egress IPs and justification. @marie can you paste the CIDR?

marie: Customer provided `10.100.0.0/22 (NAT egress)`. They require no public IPs on nodes. We must allow TLS to artifacts.redwood.ai:443

jack: FYI on onprem package we added fallback to mirror2, but mirror2 is in same region and blocked by their firewall too.

sara: Also cert: their ACME process can't reach our ACME-staging. We'll provide signed CA bundle. @ops-bot upload?

ops-bot: Attached CA bundle: sha256:ab12c9d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6. Available at s3://private-artifacts/acadia/ca-bundle.pem

alex: I'll re-run signer after INF-5123 completes. ping me when ops-bot confirms upload.

dev-bot: INF-5123 succeeded, signed image pushed at 1767778935

alex: re-run done, image now available. Test pull: `docker pull artifacts.redwood.ai/acadia/acme-edge:v3` -> OK locally

nate: @karen can you confirm firewall rule request created? ticket NET-2245

karen: NET-2245 open, awaiting change window. Tentative window 03/07 01:00-03:00 UTC. ops-oncall assign?

oncall: I'll take the window. Will coordinate rollback steps. Need runbook link.

marie: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/private-deploy-cutover (drop-in checklist). Add step: verify `curl -I https://artifacts.redwood.ai` from customer bastion.

leo: NAT rules ready draft; will apply once NET-2245 in window. Also will update iptables rollback commands in runbook.

jack: Keeping an eye on canary. Once egress is opened and signed image is pulled, we can proceed with tenant activation.

marie: :thumbsup: Can we have final owner list? marie (pm), alex (signing), leo (net), karen (ticket), oncall (window).

sara: I'll follow up on cert install with customer. adding note to INF-5123.

marie: thanks all — dropping async notes. If any blocker, ping here or call 1-800-ops.
